supported_targets.runtime: rootless Podman with podman compose or podman-compose

source_inputs.version: git revision supplied by the operator
source_inputs.verification: Before setup or update, record git rev-parse HEAD in a small operator-local record outside the checkout; the launcher does not fetch, rewrite, or create a receipt for that checkout

source_inputs.locator: Dockerfile and its declared base/package sources
source_inputs.verification: the operator must record the built image ID/digest and build log in the same local record for a release; this lane adds no unverified downloader

build.network: needed by the existing Dockerfile when the base image or packages are not cached
build.host_mutations: none; no sudo, package manager, user/group mutation, driver installation, or security-policy change

runtime_dependencies: a host browser for the HTTP GUI (optional for headless use)

persistent_state.upgrade: retain; image rebuilds never mount the checkout's data directories
persistent_state.uninstall: retain by default; runtime cleanup is separate from user data deletion

activation.strategy: rootless compose profile cpu with explicit E2A_DATA_ROOT

verification.criterion: --diagnose produces text or JSON without checkout writes, network access, package installation, or privilege escalation
The CPU compose profile expands with an explicit external data root and no privileged or security-label relaxation
verification.command: E2A_DATA_ROOT=<absolute-user-owned-root> podman compose -f podman-compose.yml --profile cpu config

verification.criterion: A marker in the external data root remains after image update and runtime uninstall

rollback.strategy: manual rollback only: use the operator-local source/image record to restore a prior image or rebuild the prior source revision; retain the user-owned data root
rollback.host_rollback: none required because the installer does not change host policy

uninstall.source_of_truth: selected Compose project plus this manifest and the operator-local source/image record; no installer receipt is written
postconditions: --apply removes only this rootless compose project's containers and network
external ebooks, audiobooks, models, voices, run state, and temporary data remain
no host package, group, security setting, or source-checkout file is removed
